chapters.title: Calendars, messages, keys, cleaning…
chapters.lead: …and a team stitching the pieces back together every day. Everything ends up tangled.

chapters.title: A spreadsheet, a WhatsApp group, a notebook…
chapters.lead: You look for the right way to get organised. Each tool fixes one piece; none ties it all together.

chapters.title: Then comes Hostay.
chapters.lead: Bookings, guests, access, teams and owners: everything in one place. A clear mind again.

say.intro: Here's what helps me, every day.
lines: My iCal calendars sync, and I add the rest by hand: one schedule.
My guests' details arrive already validated. No more chasing.
Each guest gets a space with the house guide and access to the property.
Check-ins, check-outs, cleaning, maintenance: all in one place.
Clear indicators, so I know where the business stands.
Connected locks, air conditioning and sensors: I manage them from Hostay.
My owners get visibility. I stay in control.
say.stay: I'm still here. Any question? Click “Miftah is listening” at the bottom of the screen.

morocco.title: In Morocco. By Moroccans, for Moroccans.
morocco.lead: Built for the reality of short-stay rentals in Morocco, from Tangier to Agadir.

items.a: An all-in-one platform for concierge teams, property managers and owners of short-stay rentals: bookings, guest details, guest space, operations, dashboards, Tuya connected devices and owner visibility.
Through iCal sync of your listings' calendars, or by manual entry for direct bookings.
Hostay integrates with the Tuya ecosystem: locks, air conditioning and sensors.
They get visibility on their properties. Management stays in your hands.

items.q: Does Hostay work for a small number of properties?
items.a: Yes. Hostay fits a handful of properties up to a full portfolio.
